value.rationale: The result gives a complete natural finite-graph inclusion-minimal edge-domination spectrum with nonmatching classes, an optimal census, and a nontrivial line-graph identification of the entire optimal exchange structure. Sharp one-edge immobility versus connected two-edge mobility and the uniform distance profile connect incidence geometry to graph reconfiguration, information not implied by a scalar domination number or known perfect-matching count. This canonical 14-vertex incidence graph is an independently motivated benchmark, not an arbitrary induced slice.
